criteria.statement: `graph-run/SKILL.md` states `--branch` is optional, a supplied value is used verbatim, an omitted one is derived, and it is never inferred from the current branch.
`graph-run/SKILL.md` states the derived branch is `thejudge-auto/<slug>` and the slug is proposed before node 1 is dispatched.
`graph-run/SKILL.md` states the door mints the `--run-id` before node 1 and passes that same id to `graph-preflight`.
`thejudge-kickoff/SKILL.md` accepts a supplied slug and uses it, and still proposes one when none is supplied.
`graph-run/SKILL.md` states a supplied `--branch` overrides the branch without changing the slug node 2 receives.
`graph-run/SKILL.md` states a collision is graph-preflight's exit-code-2 condition, reported with the derived name and never retried silently.
`graph-preflight/SKILL.md` is unchanged by this slice and the contract node table still reads 1 preflight / 2 shape.
`npm run skills:ai-sync` run and `diff -rq .claude/skills .agents/skills` prints nothing.
Hand-trace one launch: request in, slug/branch/run-id out, both node dispatches carrying them; confirm one name reaches both nodes.
